pamphlet_excerpts: Aquaculture Medicine Usesthe: Aquaculture medicine usesthe principles of veterinarymedicine to maintain healthycolonies of fish and other aquaticanimals.
Field Veterinarymedicine: This field of veterinarymedicine is distinct from otherareas of aquatic science, suchas marine biology.
Worldpopulation Grows: As the worldpopulation grows, aquaculturewill help provide an adequatefood supply, and the work ofaquaculture veterinarians willbe critical.
Students Interested: Students interested in aquaculture medicine must earn a doctorate in veterinary medicine.
step_by_step_procedure: Postgraduate Training: Postgraduate training inaquaculture medicine is offered at some schools of veterinarymedicine.
Opportunities Especially: Many opportunities, especially in the coming years, await individuals trained in aquaculture medicine.
Not Hear Public: You might not hear much about public health veterinariansbecause most of them work for local, state, and federal agencies.
Veterinarians Work Public: Veterinarians who work in public health are the silent sentinelsprotecting America’s public health and our quality of life.

pamphlet_excerpts: Laboratory Animal Medicine: Laboratory animal medicine and research veterinary medicinehave much in common.
Fields Apply Skills: Both fields apply the skills learned inveterinary school to a number of areas of study.
Veterinarian Working: A veterinarian working in laboratory animal medicineprovides medical care for animals used in research.
Veterinarian Member Research: The veterinarian sometimes is a member of the research team and helps design studies, interpret results, and publish articles about the research.
step_by_step_procedure: Research Veterinarians: Research veterinarians investigate new medicines, biotechnical and diagnostic tests, food technologies, and other newtechnologies.
Veterinarians Investigate: Research veterinarians might also investigate theexotic and infectious diseases that threaten public health.
Research Veterinarians Work: Or, research veterinarians might work in the emerging fieldof genetic research.
Animal Medicine Research: Laboratory animal medicine and research veterinarians usually work on a team of scientists, much like an individual Scout works with their.

However Strong Interest: However, a strong interest in science and helping peopleis just as important.
Not Easy Veterinary: It is not easy to get into veterinary school, and like most things worth pursuing, it will require much hardwork, dedication, and commitment.
Think Plansfor Earning: Think about your plansfor earning the Eagle Scout badge.
step_by_step_procedure: Preparation Become: Preparation to become a veterinarian begins today, longbefore you enter college.

Develop Wellrounded: Also, develop a wellrounded education by participating in clubs, teams, and otherschool activities.
Along Achievements: Along with your Scouting achievements, yourextracurricular activities will help admissions committees form a positive picture of you.

pamphlet_excerpts: American Veterinary Medical: The American Veterinary Medical Association accreditsveterinary technician programs throughout the United States.
Training Become Veterinary: Training to become a veterinary technician usually begins inone of these programs.
Accredited Programs Lead: Most accredited programs lead to anassociate’s degree after two years of study.
However Veterinarytechnicians: However, veterinarytechnicians with a bachelor of science degree typically earn a higher salary and have more responsibilities.
step_by_step_procedure: Additionto Coursework: In additionto coursework, students of veterinary technician programscomplete a certain amount of hands-on training, which is acritical part of all.
Finally Nearly Everystate: Finally, nearly everystate requires that veterinary technicians pass a state and/ornational examination to be eligible to practice.

pamphlet_excerpts: Human-Animal Bond: The Human-Animal Bond and the Veterinarian If you have a pet, you know how special that pet is to you.
Ask Yourself Feel: Ask yourself why you feel the way you do about your pet.
Theanswers Deepest Feelings: Theanswers from your deepest feelings reflect your experience withthe human-animal bond.
Beyond Day-to-day: Beyond your day-to-day experiencewith it, the human-animal bond affects people’s lives in subtleyet significant ways.
step_by_step_procedure: Veterinarian Role Recognize: The veterinarian’s role is to recognize and understandthe importance of the human-animal bond and to enhance it.
Veterinarians Compassionate: Veterinarians can do this by being compassionate advisers foran animal’s health-care needs throughout the animal’s lifetime.
Includes Providing Quality: This includes providing quality medical care and giving adviceto people about animal care, preventive medical care, and howto choose.
Hieroglyphics Egyptian: Hieroglyphics on the Egyptian pyramids illustrate thehuman-animal bond, and Roman legends tell about it in storiessuch as “Romulus and Remus,”.

Spend as much time as you can observing the veterinarians and their staff. Prepare a presentation on what you observed and learned at the facility and share with your counselor. (b) Spend as much time as possible with a veterinarian who works in one of the fields listed in requirement 2. Learn what special training beyond veterinary medical school may have been required for that position. Learn about any special or unusual activities required of this position. Prepare a presentation and share what you have learned about this field of veterinary medicine with your counselor. Include how this field serves the needs of the general public.

pamphlet_excerpts: Laboratory Animal Medicine: Laboratory animal medicine and research veterinary medicinehave much in common.
Fields Apply Skills: Both fields apply the skills learned inveterinary school to a number of areas of study.
Veterinarian Working: A veterinarian working in laboratory animal medicineprovides medical care for animals used in research.
Veterinarian Member Research: The veterinarian sometimes is a member of the research team and helps design studies, interpret results, and publish articles about the research.
step_by_step_procedure: Research Veterinarians: Research veterinarians investigate new medicines, biotechnical and diagnostic tests, food technologies, and other newtechnologies.
Veterinarians Investigate: Research veterinarians might also investigate theexotic and infectious diseases that threaten public health.
Research Veterinarians Work: Or, research veterinarians might work in the emerging fieldof genetic research.
Animal Medicine Research: Laboratory animal medicine and research veterinarians usually work on a team of scientists, much like an individual Scout works with their.

pamphlet_excerpts: Veterinary Education Career: Veterinary Education and Career Development Veterinary Educationand Career Development Many individuals decide to become a veterinarian.
However Strong Interest: However, a strong interest in science and helping peopleis just as important.
Not Easy Veterinary: It is not easy to get into veterinary school, and like most things worth pursuing, it will require much hardwork, dedication, and commitment.
Think Plansfor Earning: Think about your plansfor earning the Eagle Scout badge.
step_by_step_procedure: Preparation Become: Preparation to become a veterinarian begins today, longbefore you enter college.
Strive Develop Academic: Strive to develop academic strengthin the biological and physical sciences.
Develop Wellrounded: Also, develop a wellrounded education by participating in clubs, teams, and otherschool activities.
Along Achievements: Along with your Scouting achievements, yourextracurricular activities will help admissions committees form a positive picture of you.
